final_verdict.summary: No matcher-proven earlier copy was found by memory lookup, reverse image search or text search. The physical-world check was not available or inconclusive. The claim could not be verified from the available evidence. Separately, the AI visual clues report 3 unverified observation(s) that clash with the claim (e.g. "No flood, flash flood, torrent, mud, damage, submerged streets or rescue visible; ground is dry and background stream is calm", frame ref [0, 5, 18, 23, 32]); these are model observations, not independent evidence and not part of the visual-match proof.
limits: A visual match proves shared footage ('previously published'), not that a claim is false or that the footage is fake.
Upload dates are platform metadata (or an archive snapshot date, an upper bound) for the copy found; the earliest copy found is not necessarily the original source.
Search is not exhaustive: memory covers only indexed clips, reverse search rarely finds originals, and heavy crops/edits can evade hash shortlisting.
'Not found' means not found by these adapters, not that no earlier copy exists.
